WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS city_count

    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) IN (4, 5, 6)
        AND (CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2021, 2022, 2023))
    GROUP BY year, month
),
with_running AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month,
        city_count AS monthly_total,
        SUM(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS cumulative_running_total
    FROM base_data
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        cumulative_running_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_monthly,
        LAG(cumulative_running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_running_total
    FROM with_running
)
SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    monthly_total,
    cumulative_running_total,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_monthly IS NOT NULL AND prev_monthly > 0

        ELSE NULL
    END AS monthly_yoy_growth_pct,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_running_total IS NOT NULL AND prev_running_total > 0
        THEN ROUND((1.0 * (cumulative_running_total - prev_running_total) / prev_running_total) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS running_total_yoy_growth_pct
FROM with_prev
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY year, month
